Name: RP2040
Purpose: Dual-core ARM Cortex-M0+ microcontroller - the brain of the board

Name: W25Q16JVUXIQ Flash
Purpose: 16Mbit SPI NOR Flash - stores firmware and data

Name: 12MHz Crystal (X322512MSB4SI)
Purpose: Crystal oscillator - synchronises USB and RP2040 communication

Name: TYPE-C-31-M-12 USB-C Receptacle
Purpose: USB-C port - data transfer and board power input

Name: Alps SKRKAHE020 Tactile Switch
Purpose: Reset/boot switch - resets or boot-selects the RP2040

Name: 1x20 Pin Headers (x2)
Purpose: GPIO breakout - exposes all RP2040 pins for external projects

Name: Soldering Iron
Purpose: To solder the connectors and switch

Name: 100nF 0402 Capacitor (x11)
Purpose: Decoupling - filters noise on power rails

Name: 1uF 0402 Capacitor (x2)
Purpose: Bulk decoupling - stabilises power at RP2040 and USB

Name: 33pF 0402 Capacitor (x2)
Purpose: Crystal load capacitors - correct oscillator loading

Name: 5.1k 0402 Resistor (x2)
Purpose: USB-C CC resistors - identifies board as USB device to host

Name: 27R 0402 Resistor (x2)
Purpose: USB D+/D- series resistors - USB signal integrity

Name: PCBA Assembly
Purpose: SMT assembly of all SMD components
